# Appointment reports

After each appointment, Harbor Help writes a short report with the date, the
adviser's name and the next step you agreed on. Reports appear on the overview
page within an hour.

## Who can read a report

Only you and the adviser who held the appointment can read it. Harbor Help
keeps each report for two years and then deletes it.

## Correcting a report

If something in a report is wrong, write to help@harbor.example and name the
appointment date. The adviser answers within two working days.
